title: Naturality of the transported finite exceptional comparison component
statement: theorem finite_exceptional_comparison_naturality (E : Index l Ω) (e : RationalOperations.ExceptionalIdentification l X D hl (AuxiliaryClosure.{u} l) c S (fieldStage l Ω E) (BX.finite.omega E) (BY.finite.omega E) (BX.finite.datum E) (BY.finite.datum E)) {M N : Stage l Ω Y E} (g : M ⟶ N) : (inclusion E).map ((finiteRight D l hl Ω X f c S E).map g) ≫ (inclusion E).map (e.comparison.app N).hom ≫ (BX.comparison E).hom.app (op ((@rationalDerivedPullback l _ (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) _ _ _ X Y f (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).obj ((BY.finite.datum E).dual.obj (op N)))) ≫ BX.duality.dual.map ((CoefQbarPullback D l hl Ω f).map ((BY.comparison E).inv.app (op N)) ≫ (pullbackInclusion D l hl Ω X f E ((BY.finite.datum E).dual.obj (op N))).inv).op = (inclusion E).map (e.comparison.app M).hom ≫ (BX.comparison E).hom.app (op ((@rationalDerivedPullback l _ (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) _ _ _ X Y f (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).obj ((BY.finite.datum E).dual.obj (op M)))) ≫ BX.duality.dual.map ((CoefQbarPullback D l hl Ω f).map ((BY.comparison E).inv.app (op M)) ≫ (pullbackInclusion D l hl Ω X f E ((BY.finite.datum E).dual.obj (op M))).inv).op ≫ (inclusion E ⋙ BY.duality.dual.rightOp ⋙ (CoefQbarPullback D l hl Ω f).op ⋙ BX.duality.dual).map g

proof.text: Identify common-stage pullback with its normalized coherent stage-system descent. The descended functor commutes strictly with each stage inclusion by StageSystem.Morphism.functor_map_ι. This gives equality of the two pullback/inclusion functors. Equality transport then proves naturality of the prescribed pullbackInclusion components; its proof is independent of the chosen object-equality proofs.

Paste the given exceptional comparison naturality, the X finite-to-common duality comparison naturality, and the inverse Y duality comparison naturality. The inverse pullback comparison square identifies the remaining composite before applying the contravariant common-stage dual. Functor.map_comp, reversal of composition under op, and associativity give the displayed equation. This is the proved private paste_dual_comparison helper, specialized to the recorded functors and comparisons.
